gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: If the strike goes ___, deliveries will stop nationwide.
I can't figure ___ how this app works.
Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
The kids made ___ a story about a stolen dog.
gaps.explanation: make up = invent (a story, excuse). Compare make up for = compensate.

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.
